# Pinned external schema

OntoUML Schema 1.0.2, upstream commit `7a0fe7ef7d4caea8d62f2782fb3681261a75f452`, accessed 2026-10-05.

Source: https://github.com/OntoUML/ontouml-schema/blob/7a0fe7ef7d4caea8d62f2782fb3681261a75f452/dist/ontouml-schema.json

License: Apache-2.0, accompanying LICENSE. The schema and license are copied without semantic edits. Schema validation verifies serialization, not all UFO constraints. This flat schema uses `elements`, `BinaryRelation`, ID references and separate view/shape objects; it must not be confused with older nested OntoUML JSON formats. Native Visual Paradigm round-trip has not been executed.
